summary: No region-specific signal was identified for Ica. The national assessment of Peru applies, and the full national layer is carried by the parent record.
tangentialFactors: The inventory holds no Ica-specific material. Its three sources are national in scope: press coverage of a congressional restroom bill, a legal analysis by the IDEHPUCP human-rights institute at the Pontifical Catholic University of Peru, and the annual statistics of the Observatorio de Derechos TLGBI. None records an incident, institution, facility, court decision or enforcement action in Ica.
localsOnly: No resident-facing fact specific to Ica was sourced. Conditions for trans residents of the region are not documented in the inventory beyond the national framework.
outOfScopeNotes: The Observatorio de Derechos TLGBI counts are national totals with no regional breakdown, so no Ica share of the recorded homicides or rights-violation cases can be stated. Whether the national restroom restrictions are enforced in Ica, and by what means, is not sourced.
